rootCause.advancedStatus: updatePlayerUI previously called updateStatusUI during high-frequency combat updates. When statusAdvancedExpanded remained true, the hidden or visible advanced panel repeatedly destroyed and rebuilt a large DOM tree.
rootCause.hiddenWindow: Closing status-window only applied hidden-window and did not cancel or gate background status rendering.
rootCause.scroll: Advanced content could be destroyed during wheel/touch scrolling, causing layout, paint and scroll-position churn.

limitations: Automated long-running browser rendering and device temperature measurement were not completed in the container.
Actual temperature and frame pacing must be verified on the user's iPhone, Android devices and desktop browsers.
